text:
Mike R: CI on main is red — decrypt step failing on the deploy job. logs show `invalid_grant` and `failed to decrypt service account key`.

Mike R: log snippet:
```
[deploy] ERROR: failed to decrypt /tmp/ci_sa_key.json: gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=infra-keys --key=ci-secrets: INVALID_ARGUMENT: invalid_grant
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/deploy", line 42, in <module>
    payload = json.loads(decrypted)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
```

Linda T: thanks for the ping — @Dave K any idea? this smells like the SA key was rotated and the GH secret still points to old ciphertext.

Dave K: possibly. I couldn't repro locally because my cached key still works. Mike, did you try re-running the job?

Mike R: tried the rerun via Actions -> Re-run failed jobs, same errors.

ci-bot: Workflow `deploy/main` #428 failed at step `decrypt-ci-key` (exit code 1)

Emma S: quick checklist — did the KMS key get a new version or did the service account get a new key uploaded? We saw automated rotation for infra-sa last week.

Sage L: also check Vault sync job — if we push the encrypted key into repo via automation, the sync might have failed yesterday (monitoring alert snoozed).

Mike R: here's the GH workflow step that decrypts:
```
- name: Decrypt CI SA
  run: |
    echo "$CI_SA_KEY" | base64 -d > /tmp/ci_sa_key.enc
    gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ci_sa_key.enc --plaintext-file=/tmp/ci_sa_key.json --location=global --keyring=infra-keys --key=ci-secrets
```

Dave K: ok I'll check secrets. If the ciphertext in GH secret is outdated we need to re-encrypt the new SA key with the same KMS key version or adjust the workflow to use latest key version.

Linda T: @Dave K can you generate a new SA key and rotate the secret? prefer a manual rotate + small incident doc so we don't break other repos.

Dave K: on it. Steps I'll follow:
1) gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/new_key.json --iam-account=infra-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
2) gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=infra-keys --key=ci-secrets --plaintext-file=/tmp/new_key.json --ciphertext-file=/tmp/new_key.enc
3) base64 /tmp/new_key.enc | gh secret set CI_SA_KEY -b - --repo=redwood-inference/platform

Mike R: tagging for visibility: @Emma S can you watch the deploy after the secret update? will rerun once Dave confirms.

Dave K: created new key, encrypted and updated GH secret CI_SA_KEY. Also added a note in infra/secrets/rotations.md about the manual step. Pushed change.

Dave K: I also ran a quick bisect on the CI action history — the last successful run had commit `b7d2f34`, the first failing run corresponds to `a9c8e11` which touched the secrets-sync workflow (looks like an unrelated timing change that coincided with rotation).

Linda T: thanks. I'm going to kick the workflow now.

ci-bot: Requested: Re-run workflow `deploy/main` by user Linda T (#re-run)

Mike R: watching the run... logs show decrypt step starting.

ci-bot: Workflow `deploy/main` #429 succeeded — all steps passed :tada:

Mike R: awesome, thanks @Dave K and @Linda T. Follow-ups:
- add an alert when vault sync fails to automatically page infra on missed rotations
- add a short doc in onboarding about how to rotate SA keys for CI

Emma S: I'll open a tiny monitoring PR to un-snooze that alert and increase retention for sync errors.

Sage L: adding a one-off job to validate ciphertext->plaintext conversion after any rotation would help.

Mike R: closing this thread — leaving TODOs in the infra backlog. :+1:
